title: Robust Sakapatate - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Robust Sakapatate in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The heavy Sakapatate variant. Defeating one awards Sakaram.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances

Bring Fire damage. Lightning is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: Where to Find the Robust Sakapatate
How to Beat the Robust Sakapatate
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Lightning, so that damage is halved.
